name: proofstory-m0-m9-implementation
title: Implement ProofStory M0-M9 progressive intent hardening lifecycle
description: Implement the full ProofStory M0-M9 plan from docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md. Existing M0-M2 dry-run commands are present, but the remaining intent collision, contract/gate, scope shrinkage, red evidence, spike evidence, REVIEW completeness, DONE intent equivalence, and risk-adaptive enforcement surfaces must be completed coherently without introducing a second lifecycle state machine or automatic parallel child-story execution.
